comments.body: I am waiting for Peter Wincles to create contains() method for the OcflRepository class.

I am also looking at the constructor in order to develop FCREPO-3052 

 

I was going to propose the following

 

/** 
     * Constructor
     * 
     * @param storage Root for OCFL Objects
     * @param staging directory for in-progress OCFL Objects
     */
    public OCFLFedora4Client(final String storage, final String staging, final String fcrepoBaseURL) {
        LOGGER.info("to-be-implemented: OCFLFedora4Client: " + storage + "," + staging);
    
        storageRoot = fcrepoBaseURL;
        stagingRoot = staging;
        baseUri = fcrepoBaseURL;

Dan, I looked at Andrew's Go client implementation and added checks for the storage and staging existence and being directories. Also added an OcflRepository object and initialization. I pushed my commit to the origin, branch fcrepo-3040 if you'd like to have a look.  Peter Wincles has added the containsObject() method, so I am back to work and hopefully will finish soon.
Remi Malessa Thanks, it turns out that I think my constructor requirements are actually not needed anyway so We'll go with your implementation for now.

I suddenly started to receive a missing method exception when I initialise the OcflRepository :

java.lang.NoSuchMethodError: org.apache.commons.codec.digest.DigestUtils.digest(Ljava/security/MessageDigest;Ljava/io/File[B
    at edu.wisc.library.ocfl.core.storage.FileSystemOcflStorage.computeDigest(FileSystemOcflStorage.java:325)
    at edu.wisc.library.ocfl.core.storage.FileSystemOcflStorage.verifyInventory(FileSystemOcflStorage.java:242)
    at edu.wisc.library.ocfl.core.storage.FileSystemOcflStorage.parseInventory(FileSystemOcflStorage.java:233)
    at edu.wisc.library.ocfl.core.storage.FileSystemOcflStorage.validateExistingRepo(FileSystemOcflStorage.java:381)
    at edu.wisc.library.ocfl.core.storage.FileSystemOcflStorage.initializeStorage(FileSystemOcflStorage.java:212)
    at edu.wisc.library.ocfl.core.OcflRepositoryBuilder.build(OcflRepositoryBuilder.java:149)
    at org.fcrepo.migration.f4clients.OCFLFedora4Client.<init>(OCFLFedora4Client.java:52)
    at org.fcrepo.migration.f4clients.OCFLFedora4ClientTest.setUp(OCFLFedora4ClientTest.java:29)

Peter has made a small change to his code on Friday. I asked him whether this could be related. I'll let you know when I have a reply.
I am not seeing the issue building against `master` of migration-utils. Remi Malessa, do you have a link to your local branch?
Sorry, this has been sorted by Dan with the commons-codec ticket  https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-3055
Merged PR in order to work on dependant tickets but we want to revisit this to improve the integration test once the other interface methods are implemented.
